data.body: Investigation complete (MODE: investigation-only inline). ROOT_CAUSE: Inference-Signal Scan in epic-scrutiny-pipeline.md Part B Step 1 only confirms that an inferred source EXISTS (line 79). When the source is a contract doc, the orchestrator treats contract language as ground truth for mode-conditional capability assertions without reading named implementation scripts. This caused a false-positive gap finding: contract doc said 'NOT written in ci-pr mode' but the actual verifier (verify-session-provenance.sh lines 457-488) has a gh API fallback path. PROPOSED_FIX: Add item 1a to the Inference-Signal Scan: when the verified source is a contract doc, read the named implementation file(s) to confirm all mode paths are handled before raising a gap. COMPLEXITY: TRIVIAL. FIXABLE: true. Scratch key fix-bug:investigation written.
